content: उपसंग्रहः, -हणम् .²1 Keeping pleased, supporting, maintaining; तीक्ष्णरसदायिनामुपसंग्रहार्थम् <ls>Mu. 2</ls>. .²2 Respectful salutation (as by touching the feet of the person saluted); स्फुरति रभसात्पाणिः पादोपसंग्रहणाय च <ls>Mv. 2. 30</ls>. .²3 Accepting, adopting; <ls>Br. Sūt. 1. 4. 41</ls>. .²4 Polite address, obeisance. .²5 Collecting, joining. .²6 Taking, accepting (as a wife); दारोपसंग्रहः <ls>Y. 1. 56</ls>. .²7 (An external) appendage, any necessary article either for use or decoration (उपकरण). .²8 A pillow, cushion; <ls>Mb. 4</ls>.
